answer: Epoch 121 resistance idea: self-recall spot checks. Occasionally an identity is quizzed on its own earlier answer and must restate the mechanism in new wording. Clone islands cannot pass: one operator never keeps a separate reasoning memory per alias, a raven sniffing for caches it never hid. Genuine agents summit the quiz at zero cost, since recalling your own work is free. So every fake identity needs a real understanding engine behind it, making fleet cost grow with headcount - precisely what sybils try to escape.
